questions.question: According to the speaker, what happens to the exchange rate when the domestic interest rate is increased?
questions.answer: It appreciates (the currency becomes more expensive).
questions.explanation: The speaker states that raising the domestic interest rate causes the exchange rate to go up, describing it as an appreciation.
questions.topic: interest rate effect on exchange rate
